1 Cup Butter to Grams Converter

Convert 1 US customary cup of butter into grams — covers stick, melted, and whipped butter accurately.

Gram Equivalent:

227 grams (227 g)

*Calculated using standard US butter densities. 1 cup solid butter = 2 sticks = 16 tbsp.

How Many Grams in 1 Cup of Butter?

In American baking, 1 cup of butter = 227 grams = 2 sticks = 16 tablespoons. This is one of the most reliable conversions in the kitchen because butter is sold in standardized sticks with markings. Unlike flour or sugar, butter's density is consistent enough that this conversion rarely varies — but it does change if your butter is melted or whipped.

The Conversion Formula (Cups → Grams)

Multiply cups by the grams-per-cup for your butter state:

  • Grams = Cups × Grams-per-Cup
  • Stick Butter: 1 cup × 227 g/cup = 227 grams (exactly 2 sticks)
  • Melted Butter: 1 cup × 240 g/cup = 240 grams
  • Whipped Butter: 1 cup × 150 g/cup = 150 grams

Solid vs. Melted: Why the Difference

Solid stick butter leaves small air pockets when packed into a measuring cup. Melted butter pours in as a continuous liquid, filling those gaps and packing roughly 13 extra grams into the same volume. Most baking recipes that specify "1 cup butter" mean solid stick butter (227 g) unless they explicitly say "melted." If a recipe says "1 cup melted butter," measure it after melting — and expect ~240 grams.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: How many grams is 1 cup of butter?

A1: One US customary cup of standard stick butter weighs 227 grams — exactly 2 sticks or 16 tablespoons. This is the universal conversion for solid butter in American recipes.

Q2: Does melted butter weigh the same as solid butter per cup?

A2: No. Melted butter settles more densely — 1 cup of melted butter is roughly 240 grams, about 13 g more than solid stick butter. Always check whether your recipe intends the butter to be measured solid or melted.

Q3: How many sticks of butter equal 1 cup?

A3: Two full sticks of US butter equal exactly 1 cup (227 grams). Each stick is 1/2 cup or 113.4 grams, with tablespoon markings printed right on the wrapper for easy portioning.
